---
params:
  data: !r data.frame()
  indicator_meta: !r data.frame()
  orgnr: ""
title: Samlerapport
subtitle: en eksempelrapport fra rapRegTemplate
author: Rapporteket
userFullName: Tore Tester
registryName: SKDE
reglogo: '`r system.file("logo.png", package = "rapRegTemplate")`'
regtext: '`r readLines(system.file("shortDescription.txt", package = "rapRegTemplate"))`'
date: '`r format(Sys.time(), "%d. %B %Y")`'
abstract: Om rapporten trenger et sammendrag kan det settes inn her
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 11,
  fig.height = 6,
  out.width = "100%"
)

required_data_cols <- c("year", "orgnr", "unitName", "var", "denominator", "ind_id")
required_meta_cols <- c("ind_id", "title", "short_description", "kvalIndgrenser", "levelDirection")

if (!is.data.frame(params$data)) {
  stop("params$data must be a data.frame", call. = FALSE)
}

if (!is.data.frame(params$indicator_meta)) {
  stop("params$indicator_meta must be a data.frame", call. = FALSE)
}

missing_data_cols <- setdiff(required_data_cols, names(params$data))
if (length(missing_data_cols) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "params$data is missing columns: ",
    paste(missing_data_cols, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

missing_meta_cols <- setdiff(required_meta_cols, names(params$indicator_meta))
if (length(missing_meta_cols) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "params$indicator_meta is missing columns: ",
    paste(missing_meta_cols, collapse = ", "),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

selected_orgnr <- as.character(params$orgnr)
if (length(selected_orgnr) != 1L || is.na(selected_orgnr) || selected_orgnr == "") {
  stop("params$orgnr must be a non-empty character value", call. = FALSE)
}

valid_data <- params$data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    year = as.integer(.data$year),
    orgnr = as.character(.data$orgnr),
    unitName = as.character(.data$unitName),
    ind_id = as.character(.data$ind_id),
    var = as.numeric(.data$var),
    denominator = as.numeric(.data$denominator)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(.data$year),
    !is.na(.data$orgnr),
    !is.na(.data$unitName),
    !is.na(.data$ind_id),
    !is.na(.data$var),
    !is.na(.data$denominator),
    .data$denominator > 0
  )

org_data <- valid_data |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$orgnr == selected_orgnr)

available_ids <- unique(org_data$ind_id)
meta_ids <- unique(as.character(params$indicator_meta$ind_id))
candidate_ids <- sort(intersect(available_ids, meta_ids))

if (length(candidate_ids) == 0L) {
  stop(
    "No indicators with valid data found for orgnr '",
    selected_orgnr,
    "'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (length(candidate_ids) < 2L) {
  stop(
    "At least two indicators with valid data are required for orgnr '",
    selected_orgnr,
    "'.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Deterministic random draw per orgnr.
set.seed(sum(utf8ToInt(selected_orgnr)))
selected_ids <- sample(candidate_ids, size = 2L, replace = FALSE)

get_indicator <- function(ind, indicator_meta, valid_data, org_data) {
  meta_row <- indicator_meta |>
    dplyr::mutate(ind_id = as.character(.data$ind_id)) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$ind_id == ind)

  title <- if (nrow(meta_row) > 0L && !is.na(meta_row$title[[1]])
               && nzchar(meta_row$title[[1]])) {
    meta_row$title[[1]]
  } else {
    paste("Indikator", ind)
  }

  subtitle <- if (nrow(meta_row) > 0L && !is.na(meta_row$short_description[[1]])
                  && nzchar(meta_row$short_description[[1]])) {
    meta_row$short_description[[1]]
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  kval_ind_grenser <- if (nrow(meta_row) > 0L) meta_row$kvalIndgrenser[[1]] else NULL
  if (length(kval_ind_grenser) == 0L || all(is.na(kval_ind_grenser))) {
    kval_ind_grenser <- NULL
  }

  list(
    id = ind,
    title = title,
    subtitle = subtitle,
    level_direction = if (nrow(meta_row) > 0L) meta_row$levelDirection[[1]] else NA_real_,
    kval_ind_grenser = kval_ind_grenser,
    andel_data = dplyr::filter(valid_data, .data$ind_id == ind),
    spc_data = dplyr::filter(org_data, .data$ind_id == ind)
  )
}

wrap_subtitle <- function(x, width = 70L) {
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  paste(strwrap(x, width = width), collapse = "\n")
}

plot_andel <- function(x) {
  rapFigurer::plotIndikator(
    x$andel_data,
    title = x$title,
    shortDescription = wrap_subtitle(x$subtitle),
    showYear = max(x$andel_data$year, na.rm = TRUE),
    kvalIndgrenser = x$kval_ind_grenser,
    levelDirection = x$level_direction
  )
}

andel_height <- function(x, per_unit = 0.12, base = 2.5, min_height = 6) {
  n_units <- length(unique(x$andel_data$unitName))
  max(min_height, base + n_units * per_unit)
}

plot_spc <- function(x) {
  rapRegTemplate:::plotSPC(
    x$spc_data,
    title = x$title,
    subtitle = wrap_subtitle(x$subtitle)
  )
}

ind1 <- get_indicator(selected_ids[[1]], params$indicator_meta, valid_data, org_data)
ind2 <- get_indicator(selected_ids[[2]], params$indicator_meta, valid_data, org_data)
```

Rapporten viser to tilfeldig valgte indikatorer med gyldige data for valgt orgnr (`r selected_orgnr`).

Valgte indikator-IDer: `r paste(selected_ids, collapse = ", ")`

# `r ind1$title`

Indikator-ID: `r ind1$id`

`r ind1$subtitle`

## Andelplot

```{r andel-ind1, fig.height = andel_height(ind1)}
plot_andel(ind1)
```

## SPC-plot for valgt orgnr

```{r spc-ind1}
plot_spc(ind1)
```

# `r ind2$title`

Indikator-ID: `r ind2$id`

`r ind2$subtitle`

### Andelplot

```{r andel-ind2, fig.height = andel_height(ind2)}
plot_andel(ind2)
```

## SPC-plot for valgt orgnr

```{r spc-ind2}
plot_spc(ind2)
```
